channel.title: CTV News – Toronto City Hall
channel.description: Toronto City Hall coverage from CTV News Toronto.

item.title: Shakeup in race for Toronto city council as incumbent switches wards moments prior to deadline
Shaun Chen says he’s running for Toronto city council after stepping down as MP
item.description: Days after officially stepping down as a Liberal member of Parliament, Shaun Chen says he is running for Toronto city council.

item.title: Paula Fletcher says she won’t seek re-election, 2 days after registering as a candidate
item.description: Coun. Paula Fletcher has changed her mind about running for re-election, just two days after announcing that she was seeking another term.

item.title: Erskine-Smith to run for Toronto city council
item.description: Former Liberal MP and cabinet minister Nate Erskine-Smith is throwing his hat in the ring to become a member of Toronto city council.

item.title: Mike Layton eyes return to Toronto city council
item.description: Mike Layton has announced he’s planning a return to Toronto city council in this fall’s municipal election.

item.title: Toronto councillor under OPP investigation seeking re-election
item.description: A Toronto councillor under police investigation is seeking re-election. Parthi Kandavel, who represents Ward 20 Scarborough Southwest, registered to run on Friday, according to the city’s elections page.

item.title: New poll suggests Olivia Chow leads Toronto mayoral race ahead of Bradford, Alexander
item.description: Olivia Chow remains firmly in the driver’s seat in the Toronto mayoral race while newcomer Chris Alexander sits in third place with the support of about 10 per cent of decided and leaning voters, a new survey suggests.

item.title: First poll since Chris Alexander’s entrance into the Toronto mayoral race released. Here is what it reveals
item.description: The entry of former federal cabinet minister Chris Alexander into the Toronto mayoral race appears to have chipped away at the support for Brad Bradford, a new survey suggests.

item.title: Former federal cabinet minister enters Toronto mayor’s race, Bradford says he has ‘never heard’ of him
item.description: Former federal Conservative cabinet minister Chris Alexander has officially entered Toronto’s mayoral race, pitching himself as the “outsider” needed to get a city he says is “slightly adrift” back on track.

item.title: Former Conservative MP Chris Alexander to run for Toronto mayor
item.description: A former Conservative cabinet minister is throwing his name in the hat to be Toronto’s mayor.

item.title: Toronto mayor asks province to return island land after feds block airport expansion
item.description: Toronto Mayor Olivia Chow wants the land from the city’s islands back.

item.title: City councillor wants Toronto to consider making Sneaky Dee’s a heritage site
item.description: A Toronto city councillor wants Sneaky Dees to be considered for a heritage designation after the beloved venue staved off demolition when a redevelopment application fell through earlier this month.

item.title: Two city councillors push to temporarily rename Toronto street ‘BTS Boulevard’
item.description: Two Toronto city councillors are hoping to pass a “Dynamite” motion to temporarily rename a Toronto street after one of the world’s most popular boy bands, BTS.

item.title: Toronto could ban ‘surveillance pricing’ for groceries. Here is what that means.
item.description: Toronto Mayor Olivia Chow is putting forward a motion to stop the practice of “surveillance pricing” for groceries, which uses algorithms to determine the maximum price online shoppers are willing to pay for a product.

item.title: Toronto is looking to have more pedestrian-friendly streets. What could that look like?
item.description: Toronto is looking at having more pedestrian-friendly streets throughout the city, where people can walk arm-in-arm from store to restaurant without worrying about oncoming traffic or waiting for street lights to change.
